_meta.name: aetna-medicare-export-claims
_meta.description: Navigate Aetna Medicare member portal, export Explanation of Benefits (EOB), claims history, and benefits summary.
_meta.platform: Aetna member portal — insurance, NOT a clinical records portal
_meta.provider: Aetna Medicare (plan type: likely Medicare Advantage based on 'at-home health check' benefit)
_meta.authStrategy: Aetna account (MW@mike-wolf.com). Login at member.aetna.com — interactive first run required.
anomalies: Insurance portal — data is administrative (claims, costs, coverage), not clinical records
EOBs are separate from clinical data — useful for spend tracking and coverage verification
At-home health check communications suggest Medicare Advantage plan with HRA (Health Risk Assessment)
Portal URL may be myactivehealth.com or CVSHealth portal depending on plan configuration

chain.note: Aetna member portal. May redirect to secure.aetna.com or myaetna.com for login.
Halt if not authenticated. Interactive login required first run.
Capture portal navigation: expect Claims, Benefits, Coverage, Health Programs, Find Care.
Capture claims list: date of service, provider, claim amount, plan paid, member responsibility. Filter for last 12 months.
Export claims history if download option available.
Capture benefit categories: deductible, out-of-pocket max, copays, preventive care benefits, prescription drug coverage (Part D if applicable).
Download benefits summary PDF if available.

auth-sentinel.note: Aetna portal is server-rendered HTML with some JS enhancement. Selectors more stable.

claim-row.description: Individual claim row in claims table

eob-download-link.description: EOB PDF download link per claim
